verdict.rationale: Generating API reference pages from an OpenAPI spec is a fair question for a documentation framework, but nothing in the evidence shows Docusaurus offering OpenAPI-driven page generation or spec-sync. The pluggable architecture, MDX and React components are only developer building blocks that could be used to construct this, so they earn no credit. The OpenAPI probe only checks whether docusaurus.io publishes its own spec, which is a different question.

support.subject: As a developer, my API reference pages are generated from an OpenAPI spec and stay in sync when the spec changes
